reason: The Borel character is well defined because positive brackets stay positive and Cartan acts by lambda. Compatible countable PBW bases give U(g) free as a right U(b)-module with negative monomial basis, hence identify M(lambda) with U(nminus). Finite root-coordinate bounds yield finite weight spaces and one-dimensional top. The same construction on the unquotiented triangular algebra supplies Mtilde without a finite-dimensional Verma theorem. See research/phase-2-catchup-24-step3b-e.md.
